<!-- Custom Copilot instructions for Chrome extension development -->

## Project Setup Checklist

- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md file
- [x] Scaffold Chrome extension project structure
- [x] Create manifest.json (Manifest V3)
- [x] Create popup UI (HTML/CSS/JS)
- [x] Create content script
- [x] Create service worker (background)
- [x] Configure assets and icons (SVG icons created)
- [x] Finalize documentation (README.md created)
- [ ] Test extension in Chrome

## Development Guidelines

- Follow Manifest V3 specifications from Chrome
- Use modern ES6+ JavaScript
- Test locally using `chrome://extensions/` in developer mode
- Maintain clean separation of popup, content script, and background logic
